newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH H1 profit seen at 1.50-1.60 bln FFr.
newsitem.headline: LVMH H1 profit seen at 1.50-1.60 bln FFr.

text.p: Luxury goods conglomerate LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton is expected on Thursday to report a first-half profit, excluding exceptionals, between 1.50 billion and 1.60 billion francs, analysts said.
The group reported net, pre-exceptional profit of 1.46 billion for the first half of 1995 on sales of 13.34 billion.

LVMH reported in August that 1996 first-half sales rose slightly to 13.38 billion francs. Unfavourable currency movements had a negative four percent impact on sales. Turnover in the group's perfume and cognac divisions fell but sales were higher in the luxury leather goods and champagne divisions.
There is no formal first-half profit consensus forecast but several analysts told Reuters their estimates. Most of them ranged between 1.54 billion and 1.60 billion.
Shares in LVMH, which is expected to report its results on Thursday morning, were slightly lower at 1345 GMT in a bullish market on Wednesday after trading higher most of the morning.
